title: Asgiriya Raja Maha Vihara, Gampaha

titles.display: Asgiriya Raja Maha Vihara, Gampaha

description: Ancient Cave temple in Gampaha District, Sri Lanka
extract: Asgiriya Raja Maha Vihara is an ancient Cave temple situated in Gampaha District, Sri Lanka. The temple is located on top of a hillock on the Gampaha - Minuwangoda road and approximately 2 km (1.2 mi) away from Gampaha town. The temple has been formally recognised by the Government as an archaeological site in Sri Lanka. The designation was declared on 22 November 2002 under the government Gazette number 1264.
